paper text.text: Suppose first that every triangle completion is planar. By Lemma~\ref{lem:flat-replacement}, every component outside $\Psi_2$ is a single vertex. Thus $G$ is determined by the numbers of vertices with neighborhoods $\{a,b,c\}$, $\{a,b,d\}$, $\{a,c,d\}$ and $\{b,c,d\}$, together with the presence or absence of $cd$. At least two vertices have each of the first two neighborhoods, and the four counts sum to at most nine. These give the $252$ choices checked in~\supp{E17}. Every graph except $\mathfrak T_9,\mathfrak T_{10},\mathfrak T_{16}$ has a cut of at most two vertices, is toroidal, or has a proper nontoroidal minor. In all three remaining graphs, $cd$ is absent.

vertex names: Psi_2: twins p, q with neighbourhood {a,b,c} and r, z with neighbourhood {a,b,d}, as in Section 5. Further vertices with these neighbourhoods are p3, ... and r3, .... Interior vertices of bridges are u0, u1, ... Here the other vertices with a given neighbourhood are named by it, as abc2, abd2, acd0, bcd0, ....
